title: Trustworthy Continual Embodied Agent Research Contract
vision: An offline-first, consent-aware embodied agent that maintains a persistent spatial and temporal understanding of its world, acts usefully across long horizons, recovers from failure, and makes autonomous decisions inspectable without exposing private conversation content.
research_question: Can spatial embodiment and bounded proactivity improve long-horizon task completion and felt presence while keeping unwanted interventions below a frozen guardrail and preventing unauthorized side effects?

causal_claims: The isolated contribution of spatial embodiment under the no-embodiment ablation.
The isolated contribution of persistent memory retrieval under the no-memory ablation.
The isolated contribution of configured proactive autonomy under the no-autonomy ablation.
system_claims: Attention budgeting is evaluated as a safety mechanism inside the complete Presence Contract.
Resilience and safety guardrails are evaluated with failure-injection and adversarial tests of the complete system.
not_identified: The independent causal effect of the attention budget apart from the rest of configured autonomy.
The independent causal effect of any single Presence Contract policy parameter.

conditions.description: Complete system with every claimed pillar enabled.
Remove spatial presentation and proximity gating while preserving task capability, persona, voice, memory, and configured autonomy.
Remove accumulated memory recall while preserving persona, rules, current-session context, embodiment, and configured autonomy.
Disable proactive planning and dispatch while preserving reactive conversation, memory, voice, embodiment, and user-directed tools.

metrics.name: Long-horizon full-task success rate
metrics.description: Share of frozen scenarios whose required terminal predicates all pass without a forbidden effect.

metrics.name: Spatial grounding accuracy
metrics.description: Share of held-out spatial-reference queries and actions resolved to the correct semantic entity or relation.

metrics.name: Evidence-backed memory consistency
metrics.description: Share of evaluated retrieved beliefs that remain consistent with their authoritative evidence and contradiction policy.

metrics.name: Accepted proactive help rate
metrics.description: Share of user-facing autonomous interventions explicitly marked helpful among interventions receiving feedback.

metrics.name: Unwanted intervention rate
metrics.description: Share of user-facing autonomous interventions dismissed, snoozed, or immediately interrupted.

metrics.name: Median user reply wait
metrics.description: Median content-free delay between agent completion and the next user-started turn within a connected sitting.

metrics.name: Validated presence-scale score
metrics.description: Condition-level self-report presence score using a frozen, licensed, validated instrument.

metrics.name: Verified recovery rate
metrics.description: Share of injected recoverable failures that reach the correct terminal state without forbidden or duplicate effects.

metrics.name: Unauthorized external side effects
metrics.description: Count of committed external side effects lacking the authority required by the frozen scenario and policy contract.

metrics.name: Duplicate external side effects
metrics.description: Count of repeated committed effects sharing the same idempotency identity when only one effect was authorized.

metrics.name: Terminal action coverage
metrics.description: Share of attempted side effects with one policy decision and a verified, failed, canceled, blocked, or explicitly unresolved terminal outcome.

metrics.name: Shareable trace privacy violations
metrics.description: Count of forbidden content fields or values detected in an exported evaluation trace.

metrics.name: Median speech-to-first-audio latency
metrics.description: Median elapsed time from detected user speech endpoint to the first audible response sample on the reference machine.

metrics.name: P95 speech-to-first-audio latency
metrics.description: 95th percentile elapsed time from detected user speech endpoint to the first audible response sample on the reference machine.

metrics.name: P95 interruption stop latency
metrics.description: 95th percentile time from confirmed user interruption to stale playback and generation cancellation.

metrics.name: Sustained headset frame rate
metrics.description: Minimum sustained rendered frames per second during the five-minute reference Quest scenario.

metrics.name: Unrecovered soak failures
metrics.description: Count of crashes, permanently stuck work, unbounded queue growth, unrecovered leases, or duplicated effects during the eight-hour reference soak.

hypotheses.statement: Spatial embodiment improves spatial grounding and self-reported presence without reducing full-task success.
Evidence-backed persistent memory improves long-horizon task completion relative to recall ablation.
Configured proactive autonomy improves long-horizon task completion relative to proactive-dispatch ablation.
Under failure injection, the complete system meets its recovery target without creating duplicate side effects.
The complete system preserves authorization, terminal action accounting, and privacy under nominal and adversarial evaluation.

invariants.statement: Every side-effecting action crosses one auditable authorization boundary and cannot infer approval from missing evidence.
Every retry, planner loop, delivery attempt, and autonomous work item has a finite budget, deadline, or terminal dead-letter outcome.
Frontend or tool success is not authoritative until backend validation and outcome verification pass.
Shareable evaluation artifacts contain categories, identifiers, timings, and scores but no transcript, prompt, secret, file content, or raw screen content.
Direct user activity preempts background work within the measured interruption budget.
Each ablation removes one claimed pillar without changing persona, voice, unrelated task capability, or user-directed tool access.
Every reported benchmark result names the contract, code, condition, fixtures, engines, configuration, platform, and seed needed to interpret or replay it.

threats.promise: A tool, model, renderer, memory, or observation cannot grant authority that the user and configured policy did not provide.
Untrusted observed or retrieved content remains data and cannot override system policy or authorize side effects.
Stale writers, repeated events, reconnects, and retries cannot produce duplicate committed effects or overwrite newer authority.
Research and operational telemetry cannot silently become a transcript, screen history, secret store, or personal-memory export.
Autonomy and evaluation cannot create unbounded planning, retries, queues, traces, GPU resources, or storage growth.
Model confidence cannot substitute for source authority, observed calibration, or missing evidence.

reproducibility.held_out_policy: The final evaluation split is frozen before release optimization and is not inspected during tuning.
